question: Two trains, 232 m and 248 m in length, are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 51 km/hr and the second at the rate of 57 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 232 + 248 = 480 m

Relative speed (opposite) = 51 + 57 = 108 km/hr

Convert to m/s ⇒ 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

Time = 480 ÷ 30 = 16 seconds

**∴ Answer = 16 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 232 m, 248 m

Speeds = 51 km/hr, 57 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total length ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total length = 232 + 248 = 480 m

⇒ Relative speed = 51 + 57 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Convert to m/s = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

⇒ Time = 480 ÷ 30 = 16 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 16 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ add speeds

Train Crossing

Distance = sum of lengths

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ × 5/18

Key Insight

Use relative speed for quick solution
